name: playlist_items
description: One position of a playlist: the media item it plays and, for an image, how long.
lifecycle: Replaced as a whole list when members save the playlist's items; deleted with the playlist (cascade inside the module). The same media item may appear at several positions.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the playlist (tenant key).
Media item played at this position.
How long an image is shown, 1,000 to 3,600,000.
columns.Null meaning: The item is a video and plays its whole duration.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, media_asset_id) REFERENCES media_assets(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The media item belongs to the same company and cannot be removed while referenced.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, playlist_id) REFERENCES playlists(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The playlist belongs to the same company; items are deleted with it.
Image durations stay within 1 to 3,600 seconds.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX playlist_items_media_idx ON public.playlist_items USING btree (company_id, media_asset_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the playlists that use a media item, for the media reference guard.
